_why: The window each clip is read at in the runner's nightly (the EP's decision of 2026-11-14: a runner cannot read a whole clip, so each clip is read as a window at its worst moment, collapse at 60 ticks; the full reading stays a local run on Orb's PC). skip is run-pixels.mjs's --skip (ticks run without a picture first; the window starts at tick skip + 1). A clip with no entry is read from tick 1 for defaultTicks, the speed trial's way. 'from' says how the moment was found: an entry that has not been measured says so. tools/flash/nightly-windows.mjs --check reads this file. capMin is the clip's time cap in minutes (default defaultCapMin): the ticks skipped before a window cost time too, about 2.2 s a tick on a runner (run 43580079641: a skip of 950 plus 76 captured ticks used the 45 minutes), so a window far into a clip needs a longer cap than its captured ticks do. The analyser counts no change in the first 60 frames of a clip (its warm-up) and the two-second memory reading in the first 120, so a window needs more than 61 ticks, and about 120 ticks of lead-in before the moment it is meant to catch.

collapse-normal.from: from tick 1, 120 ticks (the first 60 are the analyser's warm-up, so 60 are read): run 43580079641 read 60 ticks as "no analysis file" because the analyser needs more than 61 frames. The worst moment of collapse is not measured. About 21 s a tick on a runner: 42 minutes

clash-normal.from: ticks 951 to 1120 (170): the full local reading of clash-normal (960x540, hardware, 2026-11-14, HEAD 97df40b8 export) has its worst second at ticks 1075 to 1113 and a two-second memory of 4; this window read the same ticks (one a tick off), the same primary 4.5 and a memory of 4.5. A window from tick 1011 (125 ticks) read the same worst second but a memory of 0.5, because the memory reading ignores its first 120 frames: so the window starts at 951. Cost on a runner: about 35 minutes of skipped ticks plus about 23 of captured ones.

clash-reduced.from: as clash-normal (same scene and seed; the reduced mode and the night sky are assumed to peak at the same moment: not measured)

clash-night-normal.from: as clash-normal (same scene and seed; the reduced mode and the night sky are assumed to peak at the same moment: not measured)

clash-night-reduced.from: as clash-normal (same scene and seed; the reduced mode and the night sky are assumed to peak at the same moment: not measured)
